description:
Seeking a Game Developer

We’re STEM students from Egypt who love space, science, and technology. We joined NASA Space Apps to learn and solve a real challenge. We’re seeking a game developer to build an educational space mission game. Players will design a mission and balance its budget, spacecraft, power, communications, and science goals.
summary: Orbitix is an interactive, 3D browser-based aerospace engineering educational game designed for students (ages 12–18). Inspired by the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 ("Space Mission Design Game"), Orbitix transforms complex spacecraft systems engineering into a hands-on, visual, and scientifically grounded learning experience.
details:
Orbitix is an interactive, 3D browser-based aerospace engineering educational game designed for students (ages 12–18). Inspired by the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 ("Space Mission Design Game"), Orbitix transforms complex spacecraft systems engineering into a hands-on, visual, and scientifically grounded learning experience.

Rather than simply dragging decorative parts onto a rocket, students act as mission engineers: they design spacecraft across all 4 radial sides, manage real-time engineering trade-offs
